responsibility: Provides the inline/template implementation of the gccrs `Parser<ManagedTokenSource>` class, i.e. the main recursive-descent/Pratt parser logic used to turn Rust tokens into AST nodes. Beyond expression binding-power definitions, it contains the concrete parsing routines and helpers for Rust syntax such as types, paths, closures, tuple indexing, token-skipping hacks for generic `>` handling, block/statement termination checks, error accumulation, and AST debug dumping, making it the implementation body that accompanies the parser declaration in `rust-parse.h`.
